title: Recursive puzzles
description:
Solve small puzzles with recursion.

```
factorial(5) = 120
power(2, 10) = 1024
digitSum(9875) = 29
isPalindrome("racecar") = true
hanoi(3): 7 moves
A -> C, A -> B, C -> B, A -> C, B -> A, B -> C, A -> C
```
hints: `isPalindrome(s)`: a string of length 0 or 1 is a palindrome; otherwise the ends must match and `s.substring(1, s.length() - 1)` must be one (lesson 2.04).
To move `n` discs from A to C: move `n - 1` from A to B (using C), move one from A to C, then move `n - 1` from B to C (using A).
requirements: Each method calls itself and has a clear base case; no loops in these methods.
`hanoi(n, from, to, via, moves)` adds each move to a `List<String>`.
stretch: Make `power` fast by halving: `power(x, n) = power(x, n / 2)` squared, times `x` when `n` is odd.
